description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

CWILL develops post-purchase products for Shopify and direct-to-consumer brands. The R&D Trainee will develop backend features for CWILL Order Tracking Shopify apps, integrate APIs, fix issues, and work with senior engineers and cross-functional teams while growing toward independently owning feature modules.
Backend Engineer Trainee building Go/PHP/Swoole features, integrating APIs, and fixing issues under senior guidance

Responsibilities:
• Build features, integrate APIs and fix issues in our Go and PHP/Swoole projects
• With guidance from senior engineers, read code, investigate logs, write tests, take part in code reviews and deliver tasks on schedule
• Work with product, QA and engineering to clarify requirements, share progress and raise issues, and write technical notes where needed

Requirements:
• solid grasp of at least one backend language; able to build a small feature and explain how it works
• but you don't need to know both
• Coursework, personal projects and internships all count
• understand the basics of HTTP, APIs, JSON, databases, caching and message queues; able to write basic SQL, use Git and track down problems from logs
• you read documentation, test things hands-on and ask specific questions; you share progress and blockers proactively, and take code review feedback on board
• able to clarify requirements, discuss technical topics and write progress updates in Mandarin Chinese with our China-based engineering team; able to read English technical documentation and error messages (tools are fine)
• willing to use company-provided Codex and Claude Code in your work; able to understand, review and test the code you submit, and follow our data security rules
• No prior experience with specific AI tools required

Preferred:
• Go or PHP
• Project experience with Go, PHP/Swoole, Shopify apps or third-party API integrations
• Experience with MySQL 8.x, Redis or RabbitMQ, or exposure to AWS, Linux or Docker
